note.text: OWNER DECISION (option B): this manifest reuses the referral id as its transaction-context business identifier, the same value as the interaction-1 radiograph manifest (arex-manifest-radiographs). A transaction-identifier search for the referral id therefore returns BOTH manifests; a consumer tells them apart by List.title and List.date and by requestingOrganization (here the pediatric practice, the party that retrieves; in interaction 1 it is the restorative practice). ASSUMPTIONS: expiry 14 days after publication (borrowed from the interaction-1 and -2 manifests), the manifest identifier and the example.org URLs are synthetic. The payload file in arex-payloads/ is an 8x8 placeholder PNG, not a radiograph; the digest is a real SHA-256 over that file.
